correctness.rationale: The exact bijection is mathematically sound: in the central graph each independent dominating set intersects original vertices in a clique A. A subdivider of edge uv must be selected exactly when neither u nor v is in A. An unselected original vertex v is undominated precisely when N_G(v)=A, so admissible A are all cliques except distinct open neighborhoods of simplicial vertices. The set cardinality is |A|+e_G(V\A), which equals |A|+m−sum_{v in A}deg(v)+binom(|A|,2) for a clique. The triangle-free min-degree>=2 and multipartite cases follow by elementary clique restriction. Independent checks read actual source verifier and reconstructed the bijection on representative isolated, complete and triangle-free graph cases; no finite test is an all-graph proof.
